lines.text: Two followers walk to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem, and Jesus walks with them unrecognized.
Cleopas tells the stranger that the chief priests and rulers crucified Jesus, whom they had hoped would redeem Israel.
Some women found the tomb empty and told of angels, and companions who went there did not see Jesus.
Jesus says the Christ had to suffer and enter His glory, and He explains the Scriptures beginning with David.
Jesus breaks bread and disappears, and the two return to the Eleven, who say He appeared to John.
